build_stages.name: base_setup
build_stages.description: Install system packages and create benchmark directory
commands: apt-get install -y git curl build-essential pkg-config ca-certificates

build_stages.name: script_injection
build_stages.description: Copy setup scripts from build context into image

build_stages.name: repo_materialization
build_stages.description: Execute repo_setup.sh to clone and configure Apache Arrow repository
build_stages.result: Apache Arrow repository at /workspace from commit 9986b7b10618e0da2d8533e7e440c70f3fec7337

build_stages.name: runtime_setup
build_stages.description: Execute setup_runtime.sh to create conda environment with C++ dependencies
build_stages.result: Conda environment 'arrow-cpp' with cmake, ninja, benchmark, boost-cpp, gtest, and other C++ dependencies

build_stages.name: finalization
build_stages.description: Set working directory and default command
commands: CMD bash -c 'source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate arrow-cpp && exec bash'

runtime_mounts.description: Verifier assets mounted at runtime, not baked into image

notes: Image is ready for RL agent to apply patches and run Parquet benchmarks. Verifier assets (eval.sh, test.patch, tests/) are runtime-mounted, not baked into the image.
